decisions.reason: Its value has largely been realized, with proven government adoption and connections to more than 30 national API schemes, and as a digital product it costs little to keep running, so it remains a strong asset worth retaining.

Demand for travel health requirements has fallen since the pandemic, but the API is cheap to maintain alongside the firm's passenger data offerings and still holds some option value, so dropping it now is not justified.

The verification platform sits close to the core aviation security offer, carries a low carrying cost and still has uncertain upside from tightening document and travel authorisation rules, so the option is worth holding.
